criteria.quote: AC-01 - T1 shall reach the effective high-level setpoint of 0.80 m before the first transfer begins.
criteria.text: T1 shall reach the effective high-level setpoint of 0.80 m before the first transfer begins.

criteria.quote: AC-02 - All valves shall be closed throughout the STOP interval from 220 s until the START command at 280 s.
criteria.text: All valves shall be closed throughout the STOP interval from 220 s until the START command at 280 s.

criteria.quote: AC-03 - The START at 280 s shall resume the interrupted transfer rather than restart filling.
criteria.text: The START at 280 s shall resume the interrupted transfer rather than restart filling.

criteria.quote:
AC-04 - Following completion of the first T2 drain, the controller shall automatically begin another fill cycle after the
effective 8 s inter-cycle delay.
criteria.text: Following completion of the first T2 drain, the controller shall automatically begin another fill cycle after the effective 8 s inter-cycle delay.

criteria.quote: AC-05 - All valves shall be closed throughout the STOP interval from 650 s until SHUT at 700 s.
criteria.text: All valves shall be closed throughout the STOP interval from 650 s until SHUT at 700 s.

criteria.quote: AC-06 - At 700 s V1 shall remain closed and V2/V3 shall be commanded open together for controlled draining.
criteria.text: At 700 s V1 shall remain closed and V2/V3 shall be commanded open together for controlled draining.

criteria.quote:
AC-07 - After shutdown drain completion the controller shall return to IDLE with all valves closed and shall remain
there through 900 s because no subsequent START is scheduled.
criteria.text: After shutdown drain completion the controller shall return to IDLE with all valves closed and shall remain there through 900 s because no subsequent START is scheduled.

criteria.quote:
AC-08 - Normal automatic operation shall never command V1 and V2 simultaneously, nor V2 and V3 simultaneously.
The latter combination is permitted only in SHUTDOWN.
criteria.text: Normal automatic operation shall never command V1 and V2 simultaneously, nor V2 and V3 simultaneously. The latter combination is permitted only in SHUTDOWN.
